# llms.txt — agent entry index for turvez

> Read AGENTS.md first (normative rules). This file only routes each
> task to the right doc — fetch only what the task needs.

## Start here (every task)

- AGENTS.md — layout, rules, traps, commands (normative)
- ARCHITECTURE.md — diagram, data flow, decisions
- README.md — quickstart, operator loop, examples

## By task

- Write/edit a recipe: docs/writing-recipes.md (anatomy, engine-vs-handler
  table, what the engine allows here, traps, handler checklist)
- Task inputs/outputs: docs/handlers-reference.md (never invent task names)
- CLI/API for authoring: docs/agent-tools.md (prefer `--json`)
- Secrets: docs/secrets.md (names in JSON, values in env/age only)
- Alerts: docs/alerting.md (on_failure, DLQ watchdog, external probe)
- Tenancy/extract: docs/tenancy-evolution.md, docs/isolating-a-client.md
- Fresh checkout / install: scripts/setup.sh (check-only; --init scaffolds env), README Quickstart
- New client fieldbook: workflows/_templates/FIELDBOOK.md (copy to workflows/<client>/README.md)
- Personal automations: client `personal/` (same pipeline, you are the approver)
- Automate-anything skill: skills/turvez/SKILL.md (direct → confirm → build; link into your harness skills dir)
- Client intake (interview + degustia tool picks): skills/turvez/references/client-intake.md
- Sandbox decision: docs/sandbox-policy.md (3 questions) + scripts/sandbox-run.sh for one-offs
- Where to execute (dagnats vs Dagu vs Windmill): docs/script-execution.md (decision tree)
- Windmill escape hatch: docs/migrate-to-windmill.md (docs only)

## Invariants (do not relearn these)

- Automation code = workflow JSON in `workflows/<client>/`; git is source
  of truth, dagnats KV is a deployment target.
- Durations in JSON accept integer nanoseconds or Go duration strings
  (`"30s"`); `$schema` is accepted but optional.
- New Go handler = last resort + tests + human review; no script exec.
